mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DEVICE d WHERE d.CARD_CODE = p.CARD_CODE AND d.STATUS = 1)
mapper.select: SELECT DEPT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.DEPT FROM POS_PERSON p WHERE p.DEPT IS NOT NULL AND ) ORDER BY NLSSORT(DEPT, 'NLS_SORT=SCHINESE_PINYIN_M'), DEPT
SELECT JOB_KIND FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.JOB_KIND FROM POS_PERSON p WHERE p.JOB_KIND IS NOT NULL AND ) ORDER BY NLSSORT(JOB_KIND, 'NLS_SORT=SCHINESE_PINYIN_M'), JOB_KIND

SELECT p.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.JOB_KIND, p.DEPT, p.AGE FROM POS_PERSON p
ORDER BY NLSSORT(p.PERSON_NAME, 'NLS_SORT=SCHINESE_PINYIN_M') NULLS LAST, p.CARD_CODE OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.JOB_KIND, p.DEPT, p.AGE, p.AGE_UPDATED_BY, p.AGE_UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN w.CARD_CODE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END IN_WELL, ar.AREA_NAME, w.STATION_CODE, st.STATION_NAME VENDOR_NAME, m.DISPLAY_NAME, sar.AREA_NAME STATION_AREA_NAME, st.RUN_STATUS, m.X, w.SRC_DATA_TIME POS_TIME, d.IMEI, d.LAST_SEEN_AT, d.BATTERY_PCT, d.BATTERY_TIME FROM POS_PERSON p LEFT JOIN V_POS_IN_WELL w ON w.CARD_CODE = p.CARD_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_AREA ar ON ar.AREA_CODE = w.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_STATION st ON st.STATION_CODE = w.STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_AREA sar ON sar.AREA_CODE = SUBSTR(w.STATION_CODE, 1, 16) LEFT JOIN POS_STATION_MARK m ON m.STATION_CODE = w.STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN DEVICE d ON d.CARD_CODE = p.CARD_CODE AND d.STATUS = 1 WHERE p.CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}
SELECT METRIC, VAL1, VAL2, COLLECTED_AT FROM HEALTH_LATEST WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}
SELECT STEPS, UPDATED_AT FROM STEP_DAILY WHERE STAT_DATE = #{today} AND CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}
SELECT ID, LIST_TYPE, NOTE, EXPIRE_DATE, ADDED_BY, ADDED_AT FROM WATCH_LIST WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode} AND (LIST_TYPE = 'KEY' OR EXPIRE_DATE >= #{today})
SELECT STAT_DATE, STEPS FROM STEP_DAILY WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode} AND STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY STAT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}

SELECT ID, SRC, CODE, CATEGORY, VAL_TEXT, OCCURRED_AT, LAST_OCCURRED_AT, OCCUR_COUNT FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode} ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC, ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POS_PERSON WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}
SELECT CARD_CODE, AGE FROM POS_PERSON WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT l.ID, l.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, l.LIST_TYPE, l.NOTE, l.EXPIRE_DATE, l.ADDED_BY, l.ADDED_AT FROM WATCH_LIST l LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = l.CARD_CODE
mapper.select: WHERE l.LIST_TYPE = #{type} AND (l.LIST_TYPE = 'KEY' OR l.EXPIRE_DATE >= #{today}) ORDER BY l.ADDED_AT DESC, l.ID DESC
WHERE l.CARD_CODE = #{cardCode} AND l.LIST_TYPE = #{type} FOR UPDATE OF l.ID
WHERE l.ID = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF l.ID
mapper.update: MERGE INTO WATCH_LIST t USING DUAL ON (t.CARD_CODE = #{cardCode} AND t.LIST_TYPE = #{type}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.NOTE = #{note}, t.EXPIRE_DATE = #{expireDate}, t.ADDED_BY = #{username}, t.ADDED_AT = #{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CARD_CODE, LIST_TYPE, NOTE, EXPIRE_DATE, ADDED_BY, ADDED_AT) VALUES (#{cardCode}, #{type}, #{note}, #{expireDate}, #{username}, #{now})
